title: The Maharashtra Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016
full_text: The Maharashtra Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 महाराष्ट्र आधार (वित्तीय व इतर अर्थसहाय्य, लाभ आणि सेवा यांचे लक्ष्यित वितरण) अधिनियम, २०१६. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201718 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2017-01-16 Act Year: 2017 Short Title: The Maharashtra Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 Hindi Title: महाराष्ट्र आधार (वित्तीय व इतर अर्थसहाय्य, लाभ आणि सेवा यांचे लक्ष्यित वितरण) अधिनियम, २०१६. Long Title: An Act to provide for, as a good governance measure, efficient, transparent, and targeted delivery of subsidies, benefits and services, the expenditure for which is incurred entirely from the Consolidated Fund of the State, to the individuals residing in the State of Maharashtra using Aadhaar as a sole identifier, and for matters connected therewith.
